# The garden: a lawn and a tilled soil bed (top at z 0, 5.6 x 4.4 m) where the molehills are. Up Z, the
# camera's side at -Y.
new
add mesh plane --name Lawn --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.15
scale 13 11 1
apply --scale
material new Lawn --base-color 0.227 0.376 0.290
material assign Lawn
add mesh cube --name Bed --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.075
scale 5.6 4.4 0.15
apply --scale
material new Soil --base-color 1 1 1
material texture Soil base-color textures/soil.png
material new Edge --base-color 0.376 0.231 0.227 --no-slot
material assign Edge
active Bed
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Soil
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export garden.glb
